_comment: Example --avoidable-data file. 'spells' is the master list of spell ids tagged as avoidable (stand-in-fire / easily-dodged mechanics); 'dungeons' is optional metadata mapping a dungeon_idx (matching mdt_data.json) to the subset of tagged spells relevant to that dungeon. The real list is built from Blizzard's own damage-meter classification, captured in-game by the addon and bundled by `postmortem extract-avoidable` (see analysis/avoidable.py); this example only documents the format for a hand-maintained override via --avoidable-data.

spells.name: Fel Detonation
spells.note: Murder Row (Felwyrm) -- AOE ground effect, easily sidestepped
